infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow 4Ever to use the camera so you can take a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow 4Ever to access your photos so you can set a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow 4Ever to save images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow 4Ever to access your microphone so you can talk with Core and your personas using voice.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow 4Ever to access your contacts so you can add the people closest to you to your Circle.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: 4Ever does not track you across other apps or websites.
